name: pi-auto-proxy
description: Pi extension: auto-detect a local HTTP proxy (Windows system proxy + port probing) and route all pi traffic through it while pi is running.

scripts.check: node --experimental-strip-types --check lib/proxy-detect.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check lib/proxy-runtime.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check lib/proxy-verify.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check extensions/auto-proxy.ts
